QuestInfo.name: Traveling Around Maple 4
QuestInfo.0: After observing the stunning scenery of Orbis, I should start up a conversation with Elma.
QuestInfo.1: Elma offered to take me to Ludibrium. Once I get there, she advised me to look for Marcel...
QuestInfo.2: I was able to meet up with Marcel. Where will I go next?

0.0: Alright, how was Orbis? It's hard to find a more beautiful sky than the ones here. Ready to go to the next spot?

yes.0: Alright, I'll send you to Ludibrium, a toy land to say the least.
yes.1: Once you arrive there, talk to #eMarcel#n, and he'll take you to another spot.
yes.2: Oh, and, if you step outside, you'll encounter some very adorable monsters, and it won't be such a rosy experience for you. Be careful.

no.0: Hey,do you really like it here? There's plenty of time, so just relax and enjoy it here!

1.0: Welcome! Elma told me of your arrival. Have fun at Ludibrium!
